current_status_in_sources: not annotated in UniProt, but implied by the gene name and by KEGG K04036 'divinyl protochlorophyllide a 8-vinyl-reductase [EC:1.-.-.-]'
recommended_action_lead: do not add; flag KEGG/EC carry-over for removal upstream
evidence_basis: No oxidoreductase fold among 52 Foldseek PDB hits; no NAD(P), flavin, Fe-S or heme-ligand motif; bciA (PMID:17148453) and COR (PMID:24637023) account for the activity
curator_notes: The name 'bacteriochlorophyll 4-vinyl reductase' is the single largest source of error propagation for this gene

current_status_in_sources: implied by gene name and KEGG
evidence_basis: Directly refuted for BchJ by C. tepidum bchJ mutant pigments (PMID:17148453) and by the R. sphaeroides bciA/COR double mutant (PMID:24637023)
curator_notes: Equivalent plant/bacterial DVR terms should likewise not be transferred to BchJ orthologs by name

recommended_action_lead: add as a lead, with ISS/ISM style support, pending experimental metal analysis
evidence_basis: C159/E182/C185/C193 converge to within 2.5 A of a common centroid in AF-P26169-F1; spacing +23/+26/+34 identical to the PoxR Zn site (PMID:27050690); site co-conserved as a unit across 985 homologs (Fisher OR 38-206) and replicated in 8 ortholog models
curator_notes: If experimental metal analysis shows Zn, GO:0008270 zinc ion binding is the more informative child term

recommended_action_lead: hold as a conditional lead; do not assert without metal analysis of purified BchJ
evidence_basis: Zinc identity is transferred from PoxR 5FRW, the only solved V4R structure, at 16.8% sequence identity
curator_notes: Metal identity is the main unresolved point for this term

recommended_action_lead: treat as the honest upper bound if a binding MF is wanted but no ligand is identified
evidence_basis: Fold is an H-NOX/V4R ligand-binding module with one apolar aromatic cavity (Y89, I119, H122, W124, F126, F142, W161, F166, F170) at the heme/phenol position
curator_notes: Too uninformative to be a final recommendation; prefer GO:0046872 which is better supported

recommended_action_lead: do not add yet; this is the hypothesis to test, not a conclusion
evidence_basis: Pocket is in the right structural place but measures only 85-304 A^3 in the apo monomer model versus ~600-700 A^3 for a (bacterio)chlorophyllide; H-NOX proximal His is absent
curator_notes: Would become supportable if a BchJ-pigment complex or binding assay is demonstrated, or if a dimer model opens a macrocycle-sized cavity

evidence_basis: bchJ insertion and deletion mutants lose bacteriochlorophyll and accumulate divinyl protochlorophyllide (PMID:7876113); bchJ is present only in (B)Chl-producing genomes (139/143 KEGG genes) and always with bchX
curator_notes: This is the best-supported term for the gene and is a loss-of-function inference, so it should stay BP and not be promoted to an MF claim

evidence_basis: Consistent with gene-cluster position between bchE and bchG and with the anaerobic/light-independent pathway context
The InterPro entry driving this (IPR004096 V4R / IPR024096) also covers H-NOX and phenol-sensing regulators from non-photosynthetic bacteria, so the domain is not photosynthesis-specific
curator_notes: The more specific GO:0030494 already covers the biology; GO:0015979 adds nothing and rests on a domain shared with non-phototrophs

evidence_basis: No localization data for BchJ; no transmembrane segment or signal peptide in P26169, and no experiment was found
curator_notes: Pathway partners BchE and BchG are membrane-associated, so a membrane-proximal location is plausible but untested
